timeline.summary: Kaervek asks Shauku to aid his conquest of Jamuraa; she declines.
timeline.quote: she was approached by Kaervek to aid him in his conquest of Jamuraa , but she declined.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sidar Jabari warns Kaervek that Suq'Ata, Femeref and Zhalfirins are now joined.
timeline.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."

citation.text: Divine Offering (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hakim recalls Zhalfir's dominance and Kaervek's shocking invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's invasion shocked us all."

citation.text: Ancestral Memories (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Foul entities of the Uuserk swamp spread their influence into the heart of Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: "The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir."

citation.text: Dirtwater Wraith (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jolrael says she has hidden from Zhalfir for centuries.
timeline.quote: "I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?"

citation.text: Seeds of Innocence (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests.

citation.text: Tranquil Domain (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara creates a peace agreement between Jamuraa's rival nations and a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
timeline.quote: Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Conflict and Mangara's Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Mangara vanishes, Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against Kaervek, who is first aided by the deceived Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "The Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek allies with Jolrael, persuades her that Mangara means to conquer the continent, and starts a war; he traps Mangara in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Kaervek managed to trap Mangara in an Amber Prison

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara's diplomacy produces peace agreements between the rival nations.
timeline.quote: Mangara's gifts for diplomacy and intimidation encouraged peace agreements within a few short years.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek draws the reclusive Jolrael into regional politics and they build covert armies.
timeline.quote: Slowly, as Mangara's rule took shape, Kaervek was able to draw the reclusive Jolrael into the politics of the region.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael ambush Mangara in the Mwonvuli Delta and imprison him in amber.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed him, capturing him within an Amber Prison that now sits in the throne room of one of Jolrael's palaces.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek reveals himself at the great council and demands the nations' surrender; they defy him.
timeline.quote: It was then that Kaervek chose to make his appearance, demanding the surrender of the three nations.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir entirely, opening the Zhalfir rift.
timeline.quote: In an instant, Zhalfir and all its people, animals, plants, buildings, and even the landmass itself, were phased out.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfir rift is sealed, forever losing Zhalfir from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: sealing the rift closed the nation off from being able to return

citation.text: "Rift", section "Zhalfirin rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's experiment with time magic ignites his spark and he becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: A Spark ignited . Teferi had become a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi crowns Queen Yormeba and, tired of squabbles, sails with advisors to the Chaza Isles.
timeline.quote: Teferi crowned her as Queen Yormeba

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek's armies cripple Ufunguo and Sidar Mwigo martyrs herself so citizens can escape.
timeline.quote: The attack crippled the city; only the martyrdom of Sidar Mwigo and her troops allowed the citizens to escape.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Dreaming of Victory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay and the Weatherlight land before Asmira and Rashida's party.
timeline.quote: Sisay and her flying galleon, the Weatherlight , landed before them.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asmira completes the ritual with her final words, her sacrifice shattering the prison and freeing Mangara.
timeline.quote: Her sacrifice was accompanied by a blinding shaft of light that shattered the prison, freeing Mangara.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara defeats Kaervek and seals him in the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara pinned the mage and sealed him in the Amber Prison.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara rebuilds Zhalfir and Femeref after Kaervek's fall.
timeline.quote: Mangara rebuilt Zhalfir and Femeref, aided by the new trust between the two countries.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of the time stream, taking most of Dominaria's griffins with it.
timeline.quote: When Zhalfir was phased out of the time stream by the Planeswalker Teferi

citation.text: "Griffin", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian war, Teferi phases out Zhalfir to save it from further strife.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Teferi decided to save thew region of Zhalfir from further strife, and phased it out

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Two Invasions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Urza shut down Phyrexian portals above Zhalfir and Teferi phases out his homeland, angering Urza.
timeline.quote: Teferi uses the energy released this way to phase out his homeland.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Phyrexian Invasion begins, Teferi overloads the portals and casts a gigantic phasing spell removing Northwestern Jamuraa (Zhalfir).
timeline.quote: Teferi weaved it into one gigantic phasing spell that removed Northwestern Jamuraa.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Avoiding the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi creates the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds, as his final act before departing Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Teferi's final act before his departure was the creation of the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "The Creeds of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns thirty years later to a continent near war, tutors Yormeba and crowns her queen, then leaves with advisors for the Chaza Isles.
timeline.quote: After crowning her as Queen Yormeba , she brought peace to the nation but failed to unify it.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "The Femeref secession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria to spare it from the Phyrexian assault.
timeline.quote: He phased out Zhalfir alongside parts of northwestern Jamuraa because he wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian assault.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska, manipulated by Leshrac, forcefully closes the Zhalfirin rift, and the phased lands are lost to oblivion.
timeline.quote: the phased lands of Zhalfir were lost seemingly forever, cast into oblivion

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn explains to Teferi how he could unravel his spells and promises to help return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: she explained how he could unravel his spells and promised to help him with returning Zhalfir

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska takes the tethered Radha to Zhalfir and uses her to channel mana and close the rift, greatly weakening her.
timeline.quote: Radha was greatly weakened by this act.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria, with Kaervek's prison; years later the prison is shattered and Kaervek escapes.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's prison had been shattered, allowing him to escape

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaervek leaves Zhalfir through an Omenpath after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaervek used one to leave the plane

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir and Shiv out of the timestream to protect them during the Phyrexian Invasion, tearing localized rifts.
timeline.quote: who removed large regions of the plane from the timestream to protect them

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses part of Radha's soul to close the Zhalfir rift, severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse entirely

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Disconnected from the Temporal Anchor, Teferi ends up in Zhalfir, finds only a decade had passed and reconnects with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna.
timeline.quote: He reconnected with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna and found that Kaervek had escaped his Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swap New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places, making Zhalfir a plane of its own and bringing Mirrodin's suns to its sky.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swapped New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places in the Multiverse

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirran survivors are welcomed into Zhalfir as refugees through the Omenpath Wrenn opened.
timeline.quote: The survivors of Mirrodin have been welcomed into the new plane as refugees

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the time rift before Zhalfir can be phased back in, effectively erasing it from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jeska Planeswalker sealed the rift before Zhalfir could be phased back in

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Zhalfir becomes its own plane, leaving Jamuraa without its former glory.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Zhalfir would become its own plane

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska uses Radha as a buffer to seal the Zhalfirin rift, leaving Radha near death and Zhalfir lost.
timeline.quote: Jeska is past the point of no return and completes the sealing, leaving Radha close to death.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexia switches places with Zhalfir after a coalition defeats the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia switched places in the fabric of existence with the formerly phased out Zhalfir

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The advance of Phyrexia nearly exterminates the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: leading to a near-complete genocide of the Mirrans, with fewer than twenty escaping to Zhalfir at the end of the Invasion.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Mirran Resistance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi, living quietly as a scholar, goes to the beach at dawn to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline.
timeline.quote: Teferi walked out to the beach before dawn, to where he could see Zhalfir reflected in the sunrise.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
timeline.quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Kwende Zhalfir is not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir is not destroyed!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir; his homeland is gone.
timeline.quote: Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir.

citation.text: Teferi's Sentinel (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
timeline.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wrenn meets a fully grown Seven and promises Teferi to help undo Zhalfir's phasing after showing Seven the multiverse.
timeline.quote: Wrenn met a now fully grown Seven .

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
timeline.quote: I think our time is up,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
timeline.quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi sleeps and dreams of Kroog, Argoth, and the Phyrexian stabbing him, and of Subira no longer wandering.
timeline.quote: The cold pressure when the Phyrexian stabbed him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses time magic on the path and sees the beach decline from joyful to fearful and then empty, realizing he is in Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: reached into time, pulling history from the dust

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.
timeline.quote: Nearly four hundred years later, he was back in Zhalfir.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi steps out in front of a caravan and is held at spearpoint by its guards.
timeline.quote: had Teferi surrounded and at spearpoint within the minute

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi lies to the guard leader that he was attacked by bandits.
timeline.quote: I was attacked by bandits

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.quote: I am Eshe.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.quote: She knew who he was.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Eshe speaks of Zhalfir's generations of war and loss and accuses a snake among them.
timeline.quote: Every one of us here is linked in grief,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Eshe names Teferi as the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering.
timeline.quote: Here is Teferi, the snake.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Eshe thrusts her spear at Teferi's heart and he freezes time.
timeline.quote: She lifted her spear, coiled her strength, and thrust for his heart.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: In frozen time, Teferi tells the slowed Eshe about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
timeline.quote: I loved a caravanner once,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi vows to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.
timeline.quote: I will see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi demonstrates blue mana and resumes time, and Eshe tells him to go away.
timeline.quote: summoning up a fearsome blue light

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi leaves the caravan alone, and Eshe departs in the opposite direction.
timeline.quote: Teferi went away, hurrying down the road, alone.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Months later, Teferi works with villagers hauling a fishing net and speaks with Oyana, who calls him the father of Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: You are the father of Zhalfir.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi says no one can stop the Phyrexians, and Oyana withdraws.
